Soc. 475 (2018) 94–107, DOI 10.1093/mnras/stx3141), LX-MIE's compilation/MnS.dat at commit 38cc6d97c2268d58c41ccfc3955283ab6ee2ca44, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NewStrangeWorlds/LX-MIE/38cc6d97c2268d58c41ccfc3955283ab6ee2ca44/compilation/MnS.dat, SHA-256 97d7203885af8950fc567089bcd4e7845c716a347335f404afcc9c5488f8ab91, fetched 2026-10-14; read as data, as the only machine-readable copy of its primary
licence: reduced values from Kitzmann and Heng 2018's compilation, the only machine-readable copy found, cited to the primary and to Kitzmann and Heng as the compiler: the measured values are the authors' facts, and the repository's GPL-3.0 covers its code and arrangement, not a reduced visible subset of one material; its compilation/readme.txt sets no separate terms for the data. No compilation file and none of LX-MIE's code is committed (decision-composition §5; decision-r08-licences.md)
reduction: n linear and k linear in log k in wavelength between the source's rows, onto 380–780 nm every 5 nm, to six significant figures; the source's rows are about 7–39 nm apart here, then 600, 700 and 800 nm. Huffman and Wild's paper is closed, so its values are read through the compilation (decision-r08-t5d ruling 5). n is 3.51 at 380 nm, past the longwave kernel's 3.2 up to about 427 nm, where its phase table holds n at the kernel's edge (decision-r08-t5d ruling 2).
